notes: Pinned tools the BUILD uses to assemble the payload (never installed on a customer machine). Verified by sha256 before use, like binaries.json. The CPython build is what the payload's python\ directory IS: python-build-standalone's install_only build is relocatable, unlike a venv, so the installed tree runs from whatever directory the installer puts it in.

tools.name: cpython
tools.notes: 3.11 to match the services' python:3.11-slim images and requires-python >= 3.11.
